model_output.campaign_summary: Threat actor EXILIADOS (alias: Straightonnumberone) is actively recruiting affiliates for Moondancer, a new Ransomware-as-Service (RaaS) malware targeting critical infrastructure organizations in Latin America, particularly Colombia, across energy, finance, government, telecommunications, and transport sectors. The group seeks Initial Access Brokers, advanced pentesters, and specialized developers, offering profit-sharing and real-time technical support; Moondancer employs XChaCha20+ECDH encryption and claims EDR/XDR evasion capabilities against CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, and Sophos.
